Sync.Title: Sync
Sync.Intro: Use the same data on your phone and PC: the app keeps a copy in a secret Gist on your GitHub account and syncs on its own when you open it, when you come back to it and a few seconds after each change.
Sync.SecretWarning: Note: a secret Gist doesn't show up in searches, but anyone with the link can read it. The data is only your Pokémon training.
Sync.Steps.1: On GitHub, create an access token (fine-grained):
Sync.Steps.2: Under “Account permissions”, grant only “Gists: Read and write”; don't grant repository access. Pick any expiration you like.
Sync.Steps.3: Generate the token and copy it.
Sync.Steps.4: Paste it below and tap Connect. Prefer a classic token? Use only the gist scope:
Sync.Disconnect.Confirm: Disconnect this device? The token will be deleted here; your data on this device and the Gist on GitHub stay as they are.
Sync.Error.Offline: No internet. Everything is still saved on this device; the app tries again when the connection is back.
Sync.Error.InvalidToken: Invalid or expired token. Check that you copied the whole token or create a new one.
Sync.Error.MissingGistPermission: This token has no Gists permission. Create a token with “Gists: Read and write”.
Sync.Error.RateLimited: GitHub asked for a break (rate limit). Try again in a few minutes.
Sync.Error.InvalidRemote: The Gist's content couldn't be read. It will be recreated from this device.
Sync.Error.Unknown: GitHub didn't respond as expected. Try again later.
Sync.Merged: Synced with the other device: {0} updated, {1} new, {2} removed.
Sync.Status.Error.Offline: No internet: changes waiting to sync
Sync.Status.Error.MissingGistPermission: Sync stopped: token without Gists permission
Guide.Title: Where to train with the VS Seeker
Guide.Stat.Label: Stat
Guide.Phase.Label: Game progress
Guide.Waste: Wastes EVs in {0}: the target is already met on this Pokémon.
Guide.Empty: No trainer gives this stat at this point of the game.
Guide.Tips.VsSeeker: The VS Seeker recharges every ~100 steps and only wakes up the trainers on screen: trainers far apart on the same route need separate uses.
Guide.Tips.Multipliers: EVs per battle, without bonuses: Macho Brace doubles; Pokérus + Macho Brace quadruple; the Exp. Share holder gets the same, doubled only by its own Pokérus.
Guide.Tips.Sevii: Sevii Islands included: islands 1–3 open after Blaine; 4–7 only after the Elite Four.
Guide.Sources: Teams and rematches taken from the game's code (pret/pokefirered decompilation).
